thread:
Maya: Heads-up: we'll enter the code freeze window Friday 00:00 UTC -> Monday 06:00 UTC for the quarterly infra patch. No regular rollouts during freeze. Emergency hotfix path below.

Maya: Action items before EOD Thursday: 1) finish any rolling canaries or pause them, 2) publish rollout notes with rollback tags, 3) run the prefreeze smoke suite and post results. Link to checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/prefreeze-checklist

Omar: Can we allow non-user-impacting config-only flips during freeze?

Maya: @Omar - config flips that don't touch routing or quotas are allowed but require a 2-person approval (owner + release lead) and a comment in the rollout notes.

Linh: I'm pausing the multimodal-canary scheduled for Friday 01:30 UTC. Will resume Monday 08:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Running smoke suite now. Quick log: ``SMOKE-suite v2.4 -- results: 12/12 checks PASS; latency tail 99p = 210ms; kvcache hit rate 67%``. Putting the staging build tag: build-20260309-221.

qa-bot: Auto-post: smoke suite completed for build-20260309-221. All tests green.

Zoe: FYI product flagged a docs update that needs a small patch touching the public API responses. That would be a non-backwards-compatible change. Can we queue it?

Maya: @Zoe - that's not eligible for the freeze. Please open a release-exception in #release-exceptions and include compatibility notes + migration plan. Expect manual review.

deploy-bot: Canary gating will be stricter during the freeze. Any canary that increases CPU by >10% or adds a new dependency will be blocked automatically.

Omar: Quick reminder on rollback tags: use `rollback:v<semver>-<build>` and make sure the runbook link is in the PR. Example: rollback:v1.8.2-build-20260309-210.

Ravi: Noted. Also flagging one in-flight migration: `users.last_active_idx` addition. It's online-only and backfilled; marking it as high-risk and recommending hold until after the freeze.

Linh: Agree. I'll mark the migration with an explicit hold and notify infra.

Maya: Emergency hotfix process: open a ticket in #release-exceptions, ping @Maya and @infra-oncall, include tests, canary plan (min 5% traffic), and rollback tag. We will triage within 30m.

Zoe: Thanks. I'll escalate the docs PR if we need an exception.

Maya: Final ask - post your rollout notes and smoke outputs here if you have anything landing in the next 48h so we can gate. Will publish the exec note after approvals.

deploy-bot: Quiet window scheduled: 2026-03-13T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-15T06:00:00Z. Automated canary blocks enabled at 2026-03-13T00:00:00Z. Will lift controls at 2026-03-15T06:00:00Z.
